In article <361A3AF6...@students.geo.uu.nl> you wrote:
: Hi everybody,

: Could anyone tell me why this won't work, because if it does, it ain't

: I make Masika a Malkavian (possible, but don't know cards name by now)
: then play Madness network and after my turn, before my prey's, i bleed
: him to death because i can untap (Masika) and take an action (Network)
: as often as I want.

This doesn't work. You can make Masika a Mad Malkavian with Clan
Impersonation, and he will get to take lots of actions, but you do not
get infinite actions. This is because Masika untaps between *turns*, and
Madness Network lets you take actions during another Meth's minion
phase, after they've taken all the actions they want to.

: Next,

: Can I throw the damage from a Talbot's chainsaw on my Ferryman and let
: him live (only aggravated damage hurts him)? This way I have a pretty
: powerful weapon.

Yes, this you can do.

Josh

and if you don't believe me, just ask LSJ... ;-)

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Wouter Kuyper wrote:
> Could anyone tell me why this won't work, because if it does, it ain't
> fun:
>
> I make Masika a Malkavian (possible, but don't know cards name by now)

Clan Impersonation.

> then play Madness network and after my turn, before my prey's, i bleed
> him to death because i can untap (Masika) and take an action (Network)
> as often as I want.

Doesn't work.

Masika untaps at the end of any Methuselah's turn (between turns,
actually, but that's the same as at the end of a turn).

Madness Network allows actions to be taken during another Methuselah's
minion phase, after that Methuselah has finished all of her minion
phase actions. So, first off, you can't use it on your own turn (it
has to be *another* Methuselah's turn). But, even so, it still won't
work.

Masika can take an action at the end of your Prey's (or whomever's)
minion phase and then untap at the end of that player's turn (between
that turn and the next player's turn). He cannot take another action
on that player's turn, though since the minion phase is already
gone (as well as the Influence Phase and Discard Phase which followed
it).

> Next,
>
> Can I throw the damage from a Talbot's chainsaw on my Ferryman and let
> him live (only aggravated damage hurts him)? This way I have a pretty
> powerful weapon.

Yes.

Messages.Author: Mark Langsdorf
Messages.Body:
Wouter Kuyper wrote in message <361A3AF6...@students.geo.uu.nl>...
>Hi everybody,

>
> Could anyone tell me why this won't work, because if it does, it ain't
>fun:
>
>I make Masika a Malkavian (possible, but don't know cards name by now)

>then play Madness network and after my turn, before my prey's, i bleed
>him to death because i can untap (Masika) and take an action (Network)
>as often as I want.

It's possible. It's difficult. It's fragile.
If you stick with a pure Presence deck, then it doesn't come together
very well until Masika goes crazy and gets the Network out. Even then,
you have little stealth, so you're easy to block, and your combat defense
is mostly S:CE, and most clans have ways of dealing with S:CE.
It can be made more effective by adding stealth (probably Obfuscate
since you have Malks, too) but then you run into problems that although
you avoid more combats, you have worse defenses for when you do
get into combat.
Also, don't forget that you have to protect the Madness Network.
And Masika only untaps once between turns, so you can only take one
action for each player.
I've played against this deck before, and although it can be
frightening,
I've seen much worse decks before.

-Mark Langsdorf
